items.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: Years later, I think Joe Newman told me it was he that recommended me to Basie

ctx.x: Lockjaw came by one day and said, “Hey man, Basie wants to talk to you.” And then about a week later Ernie Wilkins came by and said, “Hey man, Basie wants to talk to you.” It was the only way you’d get a job in music is somebody that’s already in the band, when there comes an opening, naturally they recommend someone, so they’d say, “Bas’ I got somebody for you.” I don’t know exactly who recommended me to Basie. I’d always thought maybe it could have been Thad or it could have been Frank Foster you © Hamilton…
know. Because I had been associated with them most recently in Detroit. Years later, I think Joe Newman told me it was he that recommended me to Basie, but I don’t really know.
Did you enjoy playing with that group?
